$comment: Manual review for eng/generate-notices.ps1. 'packages' keys are a package name or name@version (case-insensitive). Fields: license (SPDX id or name), url, copyright (array), licenseFiles (repo-relative, replace the package's own), noticeFiles (repo-relative, added), note. The script fails when an override no longer matches a dependency, so stale entries can't pile up.

AsyncIO.note: The package has no license metadata; the upstream repository's LICENSE.md is MPL-2.0. Distributed unmodified as AsyncIO.dll (a dependency of NetMQ). Source code: https://github.com/somdoron/AsyncIO

NaCl.Net.note: Distributed unmodified as NaCl.dll (a dependency of NetMQ). Source code: https://github.com/somdoron/NaCl.net

NetMQ.note: Distributed unmodified as a separate assembly (NetMQ.dll) that can be replaced with another compatible build. The license is COPYING.LESSER in the upstream repository (GNU LGPL v3, which incorporates the GNU GPL v3; both texts follow). Source code for this version: https://github.com/zeromq/netmq/tree/41a940c5893413ecda04f30af771deb4accaf251
